problem.title: Minimum Add to Make Parentheses Valid

approaches.title: Net balance without preserving order
approaches.summary: Computes the absolute net difference between opening and closing parentheses. This is incorrect because it ignores invalid prefix order, as marked in revision 1.

revisions.commitComment: naive solution, fails to account for order
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 921!: naive solution, fails to account for order
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Introduced a naive character-count balance using a fold and absolute value. Marked wrong because it fails to account for ordering and invalid prefixes.

approaches.title: Greedy tracking of unmatched parentheses
approaches.summary: Scans the string while tracking unmatched opening parentheses and required closing parentheses. Later revisions preserve this greedy linear-time strategy while simplifying the state and fold implementation.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaced net counting with sequential tracking of opening and closing parentheses, adding a result whenever a closing parenthesis lacks a match.

revisions.commitComment: refactored into functional fold expression for fun
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 921: refactored into functional fold expression for fun
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Refactored the same tracking algorithm into a functional fold with a three-element state tuple.
Simplified the state to unmatched openings and needed closing parentheses, greedily matching each closing parenthesis when possible.
Refactored the same greedy balance algorithm into an immutable functional fold with descriptive destructured state.
